body:
Looks like the issue is in https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/blob/master/src/main/java/com/google/devtools/build/lib/rules/SkylarkRuleConfiguredTargetBuilder.java#L234

It's setting runfiles but ignoring the actual value from the rule impl return struct.
Can you please remove the runfile example from the cookbook!

issue.title: How to satisfy providers

labels.name: P2

issue.body:
I have the following `.bzl` code:

```
def _symlink_impl(ctx):
  runfiles = ctx.runfiles(
  symlinks = {ctx.file.src.path: ctx.file.tgt},
)

for l in ctx.attr.deps:
  runfiles += l

return struct(
  runfiles = runfiles,
)

symlink_runfile = rule(
  implementation = _symlink_impl,
  attrs = {
    "src": attr.label(allow_single_file = True, mandatory = True),
    "tgt": attr.label(allow_single_file = True, mandatory = True),
    "deps": attr.label_list(providers = ["runfiles"]),
  },
)
```

When I now try to use `symlink_runfile`:

```
symlink_runfile(
  name = "initial_link",
  src = ":libfreeimageplus-3.17.0.so",
  tgt = ":libfreeimageplus.so.3.17.0",
)

symlink_runfile(
  name = "minor_link",
  src = ":libfreeimageplus.so.3.17.0",
  tgt = ":libfreeimageplus.so.3.17",
  deps = [
    ":initial_link",
  ],
)
```

Bazel complains:

```
in deps attribute of symlink_runfile rule @freeimageplus//:minor_link: '@freeimageplus//:initial_link' does not have mandatory provider 'runfiles'.
```

How do I satisfy the Provider?

body: I want to make sure that this is not treated as being limited to runfiles - any of the reserved words in that if chain will fail to satisfy provider requirements.
